name: Dark Teachings raises Man'ari Intuition's granted armor by 20% (#722)
contract: Dark Teachings 520251 effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (misc=8, SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) with EffectBasePoints=19, DieSides=1, so its real percentage is 19+1=20. Its classmask (family 20, dword0 bit9) matches Man'ari Intuition 523478, whose own effect 0 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE, armor) has EffectBasePoints=64, DieSides=1, giving a real base of 65. The generic Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers/SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod pipeline (no family-20 special case) applies the +20% to every effect of every matching aura, so Man'ari Intuition's computed effect value becomes int32(65*1.20)=78.
